title: Johnson complexes with simultaneous local spectral and all-group coboundary expansion

standard_prerequisites.name: Standard Cayley/Grassmann/Johnson structures, elementary spectral linear algebra and cone-method background
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Full original bibliography retained; all source-local poset, spectral, isoperimetric and filling proofs included.

core_obligations: Construct Johnson complexes and establish their local spectral expansion.
Build cone fillings with controlled area and prove all-group coboundary expansion and the stated link bounds.
difficulty_reason: Constructs Johnson-scheme Cayley complexes, proves spectral expansion and develops a cone-method/isoperimetric analysis for coboundary expansion over every coefficient group. The high-dimensional links and two-skeleton conclusions are grouped as one principal Johnson construction.

dedup.scope: Root checked complete legacy, aliases, preparation and both active lines for the exclusive DOI without neighbors. Two distinct principal constructions counted: iteratively sparse Cayley spectral HDXs and Johnson spectral/coboundary HDXs. Grassmann sparsification, matrix-poset, cone and link lemmas are uncounted support, not extra problems.
